morphology.pattern_note: 不是马来语派生词；英语姓氏通常写作 Patterson。所列 IPA 为一种英式英语读音，实际读音以本人为准。

senses.zh_definition: 帕特森：英语姓氏；在马来语文本中作为人名使用，也可能出现在以该姓命名的名称中。
senses.en_definition: An English-language surname, used as a proper name in Malay texts.
senses.ms_definition: Nama keluarga dalam bahasa Inggeris yang digunakan sebagai kata nama khas dalam teks bahasa Melayu.
senses.nuances: 属于专名，不应标为已核实的正式马来语普通词。输入未提供具体人物或上下文，不能指定其身份。马来文释义为编写说明，并非 DBP 原文。下列组合为自然人名称谓，不代表经语料统计的高频搭配。[姓氏与读音参考](https://surnames.behindthename.com/name/patterson)。

etymology.historical_story: Patterson commonly belongs to a British surname tradition expressing descent from someone named Patrick. Its history includes Scottish and northern English developments, while some Irish families acquired the same spelling through different naming histories. Consequently, the surname alone cannot establish a person's ancestry, nationality, or relationship to another bearer. [Surname reference](https://www.ancestry.co.uk/last-name-meaning/patterson).
